note: Recordings of 2021. kind: call (Google Meet), story (phone or camera video), voice memo, phone call (recorded by the phone; added in November 2026). Frames: r/<id>/f/NNNNN.webp (long side 960 px) and r/<id>/s/NNNNN.webp (320 px), where NNNNN = second // step. Voice: r/<id>/voice.json. Sound: the hours listed in "aud", as ten-minute WebM/Opus pieces <id>/<NNN>.webm (NNN = second // 600) on the branch "audio" of this repository. Originals: https://archive.org/download/<ia>/<file> once uploaded. start: the moment a recording began. Until 20 November 2026 the screen recordings of the phone stood at the moment they ended (the time the phone writes into the file), and five pieces cut from a longer recording (r071, r072, r073 from r061; r118, r119 from r117) stood at the moment they were cut; all 43, and one camera video (r108), now stand at their true start, taken from the file name and checked against the clock on the phone's own screen. The file names at archive.org keep the old minute.
